title: WMAG Gives away 99 Free Panera Meals
description: Lora Songster and Rod Davis from  99.5 WMAG gave away 99 free meals to Panera Bread on Lawndale Dr in Greensboro, NC to the first 99 people who showed up and knew the secret password.

textual.context: Presented as an on-site promotional giveaway involving 99.5 WMAG and Panera Bread; the source describes the offer as a limited first-come, first-served benefit.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised free meal is directly linked to going online or listening for a password and then appearing at a specified location, creating a reward-and-request relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not independently verify the promotion, the password, the number of meals, eligibility, or whether anyone received a meal.

textual_context_notes.observation: The source repeatedly frames the activity as a Panera Bread and 99.5 WMAG promotional event and describes participants receiving free food after providing the password.
